identity.title: Integration: conditional update followed by an if/elif/else on the updated values

content.prompt: Write Python code that sets x to 4 and y to 7. If x multiplied by 2 is greater than y, set x to x plus y. Otherwise, set y to y minus x. Then, in a separate if statement, if x plus y is greater than 20, print 'High'. Else if x plus y is greater than 12, print 'Mid'. Otherwise, print 'Low'. Finally, print x and then print y.
